Unlike most ports
column2: ports 9 and 10 of the 6390X family have configurable

column1: PHY modes. Set the mode as part of adjust_link().
Ordering is important
column2: because the SERDES interfaces connected to

column1: ports 9 and 10 can be split and assigned to other ports. The CMODE has
to be correctly set before the SERDES interface on another port can be
configured. Such configuration is likely to be performed in
port_enable() and port_disabled()
slave_close().
The simple case is port 9 and 10 are used for 'CPU' or 'DSA'. In this
case
column2: the CMODE is set via a phy-mode in dsa_cpu_dsa_setup()

column1: called early in the switch setup.
When ports 9 or 10 are used as user ports
the fixed fixed-phy is attached
which results in the adjust_link function being called
cmode. The port_enable() will for other ports will be called much
later.
When ports 9 or 10 are used as user ports and have a real phy attached
which does not use all the available SERDES interface
SGMII
column2: there is currently no mechanism in place to set the CMODE of

column1: the port from software. It must be hoped the stripping resistors are
correct.
At the same time
column2: add a function to get the cmode. This will be needed

column1: when configuring the SERDES interfaces.
